methodology.metric: Completed response with exact answer membership; Sgram fixed sample index 0, not best of 16.
caveats: Prompts and decoding settings differ between runs.
An exact-match failure does not establish linguistic invalidity.
Six Argon noncompleted responses count as failures.
Nasal spelling normalization is diagnostic only; scores and source files are unchanged.

Sas.note: Most answers add final स् or ः to the reference form. A reference/convention audit is warranted; linguistic correctness has not been adjudicated.
